goals.name: Code Migration Session Goal Harness
goals.description: Code Migration Session Goal Harness [code-migration-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hA-05-code-migration.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and migration pinned to exact from→to
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and migration pinned to exact from→to (library version, framework version, or API contract), with both versions recorded
gates.command: Session log contains from-version and to-version strings and the source of each (lockfile, manifest)

gates.name: 0.2 Procedures declared mandatory: caller census before edits, s
gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: caller census before edits, strangler or flag-gated rollout, zero shims left behind, rollback path proven
gates.command: All four procedure names in session preamble

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
gates.command: Session log line 'COORD: L2-L5 x D1-D3 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_migrate(caller_census, strangler_plan, cutov
gates.description: Harness tuple H_migrate(caller_census, strangler_plan, cutover_proof, rollback, improvement) declared
gates.command: Tuple declaration present in session log

gates.name: 1.1 Caller census complete: every import/call-site of the migrat
gates.description: Caller census complete: every import/call-site of the migrated surface enumerated via grep/ast-grep (not from memory), split into production, test, and tooling callers
gates.command: .rig/migrate/callers.txt from ast-grep or grep -rn over the repo; count cross-checked against a second pattern variant (import vs require vs from)

gates.name: 1.2 Breaking-change inventory: the target's changelog/migration
gates.description: Breaking-change inventory: the target's changelog/migration guide consulted and every applicable breaking change mapped to affected callers from the census
gates.command: .rig/migrate/breaking.md with one row per breaking change: change | affected caller files | codemod-able? | plan

gates.name: 1.3 Migration strategy chosen and stated: big-bang vs strangler-
gates.description: Migration strategy chosen and stated: big-bang vs strangler-fig vs feature-flag, with the reason; strangler plans name the seam file(s)
gates.command: .rig/migrate/strategy.md names strategy + seam files; strangler seams exist as real paths in the repo

gates.name: 1.4 Baseline green: full suite + typecheck + build all exit 0 on
gates.description: Baseline green: full suite + typecheck + build all exit 0 on the pre-migration tree, recorded
gates.command: Three exit codes + pre-migration HEAD SHA in .rig/migrate/baseline.txt

gates.name: 2.1 Codemods before hand-edits: mechanical API changes applied v
gates.description: Codemods before hand-edits: mechanical API changes applied via ast-grep/ts-morph/jscodeshift/comby recipes that are themselves saved to the repo or .rig/migrate/codemods/
gates.command: Codemod recipe files exist; each recipe's dry-run diff sample attached in .rig/migrate/codemod-samples/

gates.name: 2.2 No orphaned callers mid-flight: at every session commit, gre
gates.description: No orphaned callers mid-flight: at every session commit, grep for the old surface returns only files on the declared remaining-migration list
gates.command: Per-commit grep output in .rig/migrate/cutover-progress.txt; any unexpected hit halts the session

gates.name: 2.3 Compat shims are forbidden as terminal state: any temporary
gates.description: Compat shims are forbidden as terminal state: any temporary adapter carries a TODO with an expiry and is tracked on the shim list; final tree has zero entries
gates.command: .rig/migrate/shims.md list is empty at closure, or each entry has owner + expiry date and the session is not closable as 'cutover complete'

gates.name: 3.1 Zero old-surface references in final tree: grep/ast-grep ove
gates.description: Zero old-surface references in final tree: grep/ast-grep over the whole repo for the old import paths, old API names, and old config keys returns empty (excluding the migration notes themselves)
gates.command: Final grep outputs appended to .rig/migrate/cutover-proof.txt with the final HEAD SHA

gates.name: 3.2 Full verification stack green on final tree: tests, typechec
gates.description: Full verification stack green on final tree: tests, typecheck, lint, and a production build (next build / cargo build --release / go build ./... / docker build) all exit 0
gates.command: Four exit codes + build artifact name in .rig/migrate/final-green.txt

gates.name: 3.3 Behavior spot-check: the top 3 user-visible or API-visible f
gates.description: Behavior spot-check: the top 3 user-visible or API-visible flows touching the migrated surface are exercised (e2e test, smoke script, or manual runbook) and pass
gates.command: .rig/migrate/smoke.md names the 3 flows, the command for each, and its exit/pass evidence

gates.name: 3.4 Rollback proven, not asserted: rollback instructions execute
gates.description: Rollback proven, not asserted: rollback instructions executed at least to the dry-run level (git revert of the migration range on a scratch branch builds green, or flag-off path exercised)
gates.command: .rig/migrate/rollback.txt with the scratch-branch revert SHA and its build exit code, or flag-off evidence

gates.name: 4.1 Migration notes written: from→to, breaking changes hit, deci
gates.description: Migration notes written: from→to, breaking changes hit, decisions made, remaining risks, and the rollback pointer — filed at docs/ or .rig/migrate/MIGRATION-NOTES.md
gates.command: File exists with all five sections; linked from the final commit message

gates.name: 4.2 Improvement entry written: one lesson (codemod worth keeping
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one lesson (codemod worth keeping, census gap, doc gap in upstream guide)

preconditions.startup_phrase: Every caller migrates or is named. Clean cutover or no cutover.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for caller census and cutover verification; A2 for codemods; A3 for docs only; A4 forbidden

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times → codemod recipe promoted to repo tooling, or census pattern library updated

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates
cutover-proof.txt shows zero old-surface references at final SHA
shims.md is empty or the session is explicitly closed as 'partial — strangler in flight' with named seams
Identity closure: coordinate, cutover verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: notes: a migration that cannot prove rollback degrades to a strangler-partial close, never to a forced big-bang
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.1, 4.1: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and migration pinned to exact from→to (library version, framework version, or API contract), with both versions recorded
Procedures declared mandatory: caller census before edits, strangler or flag-gated rollout, zero shims left behind, rollback path proven
RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
Harness tuple H_migrate(caller_census, strangler_plan, cutover_proof, rollback, improvement) declared
Caller census complete: every import/call-site of the migrated surface enumerated via grep/ast-grep (not from memory), split into production, test, and tooling callers
Breaking-change inventory: the target's changelog/migration guide consulted and every applicable breaking change mapped to affected callers from the census
Migration strategy chosen and stated: big-bang vs strangler-fig vs feature-flag, with the reason; strangler plans name the seam file(s)
Baseline green: full suite + typecheck + build all exit 0 on the pre-migration tree, recorded
Codemods before hand-edits: mechanical API changes applied via ast-grep/ts-morph/jscodeshift/comby recipes that are themselves saved to the repo or .rig/migrate/codemods/
No orphaned callers mid-flight: at every session commit, grep for the old surface returns only files on the declared remaining-migration list
Compat shims are forbidden as terminal state: any temporary adapter carries a TODO with an expiry and is tracked on the shim list; final tree has zero entries
Zero old-surface references in final tree: grep/ast-grep over the whole repo for the old import paths, old API names, and old config keys returns empty (excluding the migration notes themselves)
Full verification stack green on final tree: tests, typecheck, lint, and a production build (next build / cargo build --release / go build ./... / docker build) all exit 0
Behavior spot-check: the top 3 user-visible or API-visible flows touching the migrated surface are exercised (e2e test, smoke script, or manual runbook) and pass
Rollback proven, not asserted: rollback instructions executed at least to the dry-run level (git revert of the migration range on a scratch branch builds green, or flag-off path exercised)
Migration notes written: from→to, breaking changes hit, decisions made, remaining risks, and the rollback pointer — filed at docs/ or .rig/migrate/MIGRATION-NOTES.md
Improvement entry written: one lesson (codemod worth keeping, census gap, doc gap in upstream guide)

final_rule: Census before edits; memory is not a census.
No cutover claim without a green build and an exercised rollback.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every code-migration session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: a migration that cannot prove rollback degrades to a strangler-partial close, never to a forced big-bang
